$note: The Hortus hardware shop: what the page shows and in what words. Hand-written in English from the maker's own pages (shop/source/emode.json, imported by tools/shop/import-emode.mjs). tools/shop/render.mjs turns this into markup. Every number here is a fact in brand/ledger.json (hortus.shop.*); every photo is in ledger → media. "keys" names the two specs a product's card shows on the packed hardware list.
$live: true: the shop and the Machina and Arca previews render everywhere: the claude.ai Artifact and the web build (lastfomo.vercel.app once this reaches the production branch). The owner approved them to go live on 26 October 2026, after a last test on their own devices. Set false to take them off the web build again; the Artifact keeps them.
$maker: The name the page gives the maker, and the Hortus product names, are the owner's (26 October 2026). The products and their photos come from E-MODE (e-mode.pro), imported by tools/shop/import-emode.mjs; each product's "source" is its key in shop/emode-products.json and shop/source/. The page does not say where the hardware is made (the owner's choice).
$prices: Prices in US dollars by the owner's rule of 26 October 2026: the maker's rouble list price of 25 October 2026 (shop/source/emode.json) divided by 100 and rounded to the dollar. Each is a fact in brand/ledger.json (hortus.shop.*).

products.name: HortusPilot N
products.line: Nutrient solution, held to the recipe.
products.lead: Keeps the EC and pH of the feed in a hydroponic system or a water-preparation line. It doses up to three nutrients, tops up water from a level sensor and watches the temperature of the solution and the air.
products.alt: The HortusPilot N dosing controller: five peristaltic pumps above five labelled bottles

does.s: Feeds to the set EC, then corrects pH with pH+ and pH−
Each dose sized against the live reading
Tops up the control tank from the level sensor
Solution and air
On the unit, over the local network or online, with history in the maker’s cloud

specs: Seedlings, growth, pre-flower, flower, harvest, preparation

products.name: HortusPilot F
products.line: The whole feed line, on one panel.
products.lead: The larger HortusPilot. EC, pH, level and solution temperature for tanks of 60 to 2,000 litres, with a colour touch screen, Wi-Fi, and RS-485 to join a wider control system.
products.alt: The HortusPilot F panel: five pumps above five bottles, pH− and pH+ on the left

does.s: Up to three nutrients, then pH+ and pH−
Warns before a nutrient or reagent runs out
Leak, sampler and channel checks among 26 alarms
The tank, a channel or the whole system
Drives outside equipment up to 100 W, not included

box: Controller with sampler, tubing and five bottles fitted

products.name: HortusPilot pH
products.lead: Measures and corrects the pH of a nutrient solution between 3.0 and 12.0, in reservoirs of 20 to 2,000 litres. Two pumps, pH+ and pH−, run under an adaptive controller.
products.alt: The HortusPilot pH controller: two peristaltic pumps marked pH− and pH+, with its electrode on a cable

does.s: A PI controller that follows the solution as it changes
pH allowed to swing, as it does in nature
Holds 5.0 to 8.0 with protection on; alarms if the electrode fails
Wi-Fi to the maker’s cloud, with alarms by email

products.name: HortusRoom A
products.line: Heat and humidity, on two channels.
products.lead: Holds air temperature and humidity on two independent channels: a heater on one, a cooler on the other, each up to 1,500 W.
products.alt: The HortusRoom A controller: two sockets beside a small screen, with its sensor on a cable

does.s: Each set on its own, up to 1,500 W
Automatic, a repeating timer, or set times
Temperature and humidity in one digital sensor
Dims the screen and keeps working

products.name: HortusRoom C
products.line: CO₂, raised while the light is on.
products.lead: Measures carbon dioxide and holds it in a greenhouse, grow room or tent, switching a regulator, fan or damper from one controlled socket. In a public room it ventilates when CO₂ climbs.
products.alt: The HortusRoom C controller: a white case with a screen and three buttons, cables below

does.s: Enrichment for growing; ventilation for rooms
A switched socket for up to 100 W
Wi-Fi to the maker’s cloud, with graphs of every reading
Plants use the extra CO₂ only while they photosynthesise

products.name: HortusRoom S
products.lead: Reads moisture in the root zone and waters on time, in soil or substrate, with nobody in the room. One sensor can run a group of like plants.
products.alt: The HortusRoom S controller: a socket below a small screen, its moisture probe on a cable

does.s: Moisture, watering time and the pause between
Up to 1,500 W
Waters a bed of like plants from one reading

machina.$note: The Machina preview on its case: what Machina does (builds private AI on site, sources the hardware when the market is tight), and a study of what the same hardware costs now against its launch price. Every number is a dated, sourced fact in brand/ledger.json (machina.study.*).

screen.title: The hardware is getting dearer.
screen.lead: We build private AI on your premises, and source the cards and machines for it when the market is tight. What the same hardware costs now, against its launch price:
screen.outlook: Memory is behind it, and it is not over: TrendForce expects the price of AI memory to more than double again in 2027, with supply short all year. Choose a machine to see its prices.
screen.note: US dollars, log scale. Reports to 26 October 2026.

study.name: GeForce RTX 5080
study.story: GeForce RTX 5080: $999 at launch in January 2025; new cards asked at least $1,450 in October 2026.

study.name: GeForce RTX 5090
study.story: GeForce RTX 5090: $1,999 at launch in January 2025; from $4,299 at the cheapest retailers in October 2026, and gone from several shelves.

study.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark
study.story: NVIDIA DGX Spark: $3,999 at launch in October 2025; $4,699 from February 2026, when NVIDIA pointed to memory supply; $6,950 from 23 October 2026.

study.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000
study.story: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000: $8,565 when it reached shops in April 2025; $16,000 in NVIDIA’s own store from August 2026. It carries 96 GB of memory.
